svg.title: Every human trial of LL-37 we found: all small or local
svg.desc: Every human trial of LL-37 we found: all small or local. 2014: Venous leg ulcers, on the skin, 34 people, Randomized vs placebo; Faster healing at 2 lower strengths, not the highest. 2015–20: Melanoma, injected into tumors, 3 treated people, No control group; Results too sparse to judge; skin lesions reported. 2021: Venous leg ulcers, on the skin, 148 people, Randomized vs placebo; No difference on closure; post hoc large-wound signal. 2023: Diabetic foot ulcers, cream, 25 people, Randomized vs placebo; Better granulation; no effect on bacteria or inflammation. —: Injected under the skin, or by mouth, 0 people, No trial found; No controlled human data on these routes.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
